summary: Assess ticket impact during README creation

delivery.outcome: Assess initial file and SQLite tickets through subactor/ticket-radar and include the advisory result in their generated README. Test and publish through independent protected validation.
nonGoals: No execution/merge authority from radar scores.
No automatic runtime installation or rewriting historical tickets.

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing external product CLI via argv/stdin; managed ticket-storage bridge renders bounded advisory Markdown for both ticket stores after actual scope is known. Amended (same objective): the CI wiring guard requires the radar suite to be wired through tests/governance-scripts.test.sh, added to scope and the component; budget files raised 3->4 accordingly.
interfaceChanges: Add managed ticket_storage radar command and initial advisory README section.
architecture.rollback: Revert creation integration through protected review; existing tickets and intent semantics are unchanged.
